descripcion.message: Syncs your PlayStation trophies and Epic achievements with Paragon by reading your own session in this browser, without copying tokens by hand.

conectado.message: Connected. PSN: press to sync. Epic: open your “My Achievements” page first.

leyendoEpic.message: Reading your Epic achievements… this may take a moment.

listoEpic.message: Done — $JUEGOS$ Epic game(s) synced as $USUARIO$. They show as self-reported progress (they don't count for rankings).

err_sin_sesion_psn.message: No PlayStation session found in this browser — open playstation.com, sign in and try again.

err_abre_mis_logros.message: Open your “My Achievements” page on store.epicgames.com (avatar → My Achievements), signed in, and press again.

err_recarga_epic.message: Reload the Epic tab (F5) and try again: it was opened before the extension was installed.

err_perfil_privado.message: Epic isn't returning your achievements: in “My Achievements” → “Privacy level”, set it to Public and try again.

err_perfil_no_encontrado.message: Epic isn't returning that profile. Check that you're on your “My Achievements” page.

err_epic_reto.message: Epic is asking you to prove you're human. Open the Epic website normally, complete it and try again.

err_epic_no_responde.message: Epic didn't respond. Try again in a moment.

err_no_es_pagina_de_logros.message: Open your Epic “My Achievements” page (the URL ends in /u/ and a code).
